name: Default
shortDescription: Open source enterprise social network for intranets and communities, with spaces, profiles, activity streams and modules, backed by MariaDB.

alerts.message: Open the domain after the first start to finish the web installer: the database is already configured, and the account you create there becomes the administrator. Configure SMTP in the installer or later under Administration so notification and registration emails are delivered.
This image runs on x86_64 servers only.
